tokens.name: layout.primary
tokens.role: Compact mobile pane that reorders by window size and task. A small viewport exposes the next useful action without removing context or recovery.

tokens.name: type.hierarchy
tokens.notes: No owner fonts or exact type values are stored.
tokens.role: Humanist sans type keeps instructions and repeated controls approachable without softening their meaning. Window size, posture, orientation, and device variation change arrangement before they change meaning.

tokens.name: color.role
tokens.notes: The role is analytical; preview colors are original study values.
tokens.role: Navigation, system bars, sheets, and edge treatment remain coherent with Android behavior.

tokens.name: interaction.priority
tokens.role: Touch targets, focus, gestures, keyboard paths, and visible state survive one-handed and assistive use.

tokens.name: media.strategy
tokens.notes: Destination media requires its own rights and art direction.
tokens.role: Adaptive Android phone task with visible system context and reachable controls. Icons identify action or state and never carry meaning alone.
